the week happens but there are a couple extra days we have a good time AMI is the best but now ive gotta job to do
lines.zh: 这一周就这么过去了，只是多出几天，我们过得很开心，AMI 最棒了，不过现在我有正事要办了

lines.en: scene back2school4
: So...yeah. I’m back.
lines.zh: : 所以……嗯。我回来了。

lines.en: : {i}Yeah. I can see that. And here I was beginning to think I’d have to bury your niece.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}是啊。我看得出来。我还正开始琢磨，是不是得替你把你的侄女给埋了呢。{/i}

lines.en: : I don’t think that will be necessary. She did a great job, all things considered.
lines.zh: : 考虑到种种情况，她已经做得很好了。

lines.en: : {i}“All things” meaning the fact that you’re so devoted to suffering in silence that you’d completely disregard me {b}again?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}所谓「种种情况」，指的该不会是你那么热衷于一个人默默受苦，以至于{b}又一次{/b}要把我完全抛在脑后吧？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I could have helped too, you know. Granted, I still have no clue what even fucking happened. But it’d be nice if you told Ami to maybe make an exception for me the {b}next{/b} time you have a mental breakdown.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我本来也是能帮忙的，你知道吧。当然，我到现在也不知道到底他妈的发生了什么。不过，下次你精神崩溃的时候，能不能让 Ami 为我破个例？那样我会很高兴。{/i}

lines.en: : Sorry. I’ll be sure to anticipate the sudden striking of tragedy a little better in the future so as to not inconvenience you any further.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我以后一定会更准确地预判悲剧的突然降临，免得再给你添更多麻烦。

lines.en: scene back2school5
: Good. So how are you feeling {i}now?{/i}
lines.zh: : 很好。那你{i}现在{/i}感觉怎么样？

lines.en: : Do you want to talk about it?
lines.zh: : 你想聊聊吗？

lines.en: : {i}What do you think?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你觉得呢？{/i}

lines.en: : That I really hope I’m not going to have to take you on another tour down memory lane since my feet still kind of hurt from the last one.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我真心希望不用再陪你重游一遍记忆的旧路了，上一次走下来我的脚到现在还有点疼。

lines.en: : {i}I don’t think that’ll be necessary, Niki.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我觉得没那个必要，Niki。{/i}

lines.en: : Is Ami with you right now?
lines.zh: : Ami 现在和你在一起吗？

lines.en: : {i}Yeah. We’re on our way to school.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}嗯。我们正在去学校的路上。{/i}

lines.en: scene back2school6
: You’re going back to work already? Are you a fucking lunatic? You’ve been in what was effectively a coma for two months. Take some more time off.
lines.zh: : 你这就打算回去上班了？你他妈的是疯子吗？你可是等于昏迷了两个月啊。再多休息一阵吧。

lines.en: : {i}I’m not working today. I just want to explain what happened to everyone and...let them know I’m not dead.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我今天不是去上班。我只是想跟大家解释一下发生了什么，还有……让他们知道我没死。{/i}

lines.en: : Does Noriko know yet?
lines.zh: : Noriko 知道了吗？

lines.en: : {i}No. You’re the first person I’ve called.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}没有。你是我第一个打给的人。{/i}

lines.en: : Are you just saying that to make me happy?
lines.zh: : 你这么说只是为了哄我开心吧？

lines.en: : {i}I’m really not. I just got my phone back a couple minutes ago.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}真不是。我几分钟前才刚拿回手机。{/i}

lines.en: scene back2school7
: That makes it sound like you were grounded.
lines.zh: : 这么说听着倒像是你被禁足了一样。

lines.en: : {i}Well...{/i}
: Hey, remember that one time you actually {i}were{/i} grounded? And I helped you climb out of your window so we could hang out and, like...what did we do again? Throw rocks at stuff?
lines.zh: : 嘿，还记得那次你真的{i}被禁足{/i}了吗？我帮你从窗户爬出来，我们好一起玩，然后……我们当时干什么来着？拿石头砸东西？

lines.en: : {i}I wish I knew.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我要是还记得就好了。{/i}

lines.en: scene back2school8
: Oh, right. {i}Amnesia.{/i}
lines.zh: : 哦，对。{i}失忆。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Something like that.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}差不多是那样吧。{/i}

lines.en: : Hey, Akira...
lines.zh: : 嘿，Akira……

lines.en: : {i}What’s up?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}怎么了？{/i}

lines.en: : I love you.
lines.zh: : 我爱你。

lines.en: : Embarrassed to say it back in front of Ami?
lines.zh: : 当着 Ami 的面不好意思说回来？

lines.en: : {i}It’d be safer for both of us if I don’t.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我不说的话，对我们两个都更安全。{/i}

lines.en: : Booooooooring.
: {i}Yeah. So, what are your plans for the rest of the day?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}是吗。那么，今天接下来你有什么打算？{/i}

lines.en: scene back2school9
: Work. I’ve got a commercial for some mobile game later. Then dance lessons after that. Then, I’m meeting up with Otoha for a quick lesson since we didn’t get to have any over winter break.
lines.zh: : 工作。晚点要拍个什么手游的广告。然后是舞蹈课。再之后要和 Otoha 见一面上一小课，因为寒假期间我们一节都没上成。

lines.en: : {i}Did you hear that she and Rin broke up?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你听说了吗，她和 Rin 分手了？{/i}

lines.en: : I don’t see how that has any relevance to me whatsoever. And unlike you, I know better than to get myself involved in my pupils’ love affairs.
lines.zh: : 我看不出这跟我有半点关系。而且不像你，我可不会蠢到掺和进自己学生的恋爱纠纷里。

lines.en: : {i}Harsh. {/i}
: How about you? What’s on the docket after you inform your class that you’ve become a zombie?
lines.zh: : 你呢？通知完你们班说你变成僵尸之后，接下来还有什么安排？

lines.en: : {i}Probably sitting in a dark corner and hating myself until the sun comes up tomorrow.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}大概就是坐在某个黑暗的角落里痛恨自己，一直恨到明天太阳升起来吧。{/i}

lines.en: scene back2school10
: Want me to cancel Otoha’s lesson and come fuck the gloom out of you?
lines.zh: : 要不要我把 Otoha 的课取消，过去把你身上的阴郁给操出来？

lines.en: : {i}You’re on speaker, you know.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你现在开着免提呢，你知道吗。{/i}

lines.en: scene back2school11
: Hi, Ami. Your uncle’s got a fat cock.
lines.zh: : 嗨，Ami。你舅舅有条大鸡巴。

lines.en: : {i}Wow. Okay. Remind me to never actually put you on speakerphone.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}哇。行吧。提醒我以后千万别再真的开免提了。{/i}

lines.en: : I can tell when you’re lying to me, asshole. But that’s why I’m so worried after hearing that “sitting in a dark corner” shit. Take it easy, would you?
lines.zh: : 你是不是在骗我，我可听得出来，混蛋。但也正因如此，听到那句「坐在黑暗角落」的鬼话，我才这么担心。你悠着点，行吗？

lines.en: : {i}I’m trying. That’s where the dark corner comes into play. But I should probably hang up now. Ami’s starting to give me the death stare.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我在努力了。所以才需要那个黑暗的角落嘛。不过我大概该挂了。Ami 开始用杀死人的眼神瞪我了。{/i}

lines.en: scene back2school8
: Okay.
lines.zh: : 好吧。

lines.en: : I’m glad you’re feeling better. Even if “better” isn’t actually {i}better{/i} and you’re just kind of...conscious again.
lines.zh: : 我很高兴你好些了。哪怕这个「好些」其实并不是{i}好些{/i}，只是你又……恢复意识了而已。

lines.en: : I missed you. And for the zillionth time even though I know you won’t listen, you can always talk to me if you need anything.
lines.zh: : 我很想你。还有，尽管我知道你不会听，我还是第一万次重申：你需要什么，随时都可以来跟我说。

lines.en: : {i}I think I might actually do that soon. {/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我想这次我说不定真的会去找你的。{/i}

lines.en: : I’ll believe it when I see it. Love you, baby. Have fun at school.
lines.zh: : 眼见为实吧。爱你，宝贝。在学校开心点。

lines.en: : {i}Have fun being famous.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}祝你当名人当得开心。{/i}

lines.en: : I always do.
lines.zh: : 我一直都很开心。

lines.en: scene back2school12
scene black
: Baka.
lines.zh: : 笨蛋。

lines.en: scene sky
: That was way longer than a minute...
lines.zh: : 这可比一分钟长多了……

lines.en: : Yeah, I figured I owed her a little more since she used to have the same job as you.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我觉得该多给她一点时间，毕竟她以前干过和你一样的工作。

lines.en: : Huh? When did {i}you{/i} find out Niki was the number one maid? That’s supposed to be a secret known only to the girls of the cafe. It’s part of our initiation.
lines.zh: : 咦？你{i}是什么时候{/i}知道 Niki 是头牌女仆的？那本来应该是只有咖啡馆的女孩们才知道的秘密。这是我们入伙仪式的一部分。

lines.en: : I meant caretaker. Also, what? The number one maid has been her this entire time?
lines.zh: : 我是说看护人。还有，什么？头牌女仆从头到尾一直是她？

lines.en: : It was just once for a promo thing a long time ago and-
lines.zh: : 那只是很久以前一次宣传活动而已，而且——

lines.en: : Wait...stop talking to me so casually. It’s giving me less time to talk you out of this insanely stupid and dangerous decision you’re making right now.
lines.zh: : 等等……别用这么随意的口气跟我说话。这样我就没什么时间劝你放弃你正在做的这个蠢到极点又危险的决定。

lines.en: : We can still turn around. We haven’t made it to the gates yet.
lines.zh: : 我们还能回头。我们还没走到校门口呢。

lines.en: : I’m not turning around, Ami.
lines.zh: : 我不回头，Ami。

lines.en: : Well...what if I just...tell everyone you’re okay now?! That should work, right? Here. Let’s take a selfie I can show them as evidence.
lines.zh: : 那……我要不干脆……跟大家说你现在没事了？！这样总行了吧？来，我们拍张自拍，我拿给他们当证据。

lines.en: : You know what would be better than that? Me actually showing myself in person. {i}Then{/i} I can go back into hiding until the weight of the world lets up a little.
lines.zh: : 你知道什么比那更好吗？我亲自露面。{i}然后{/i}我就能重新躲起来，一直躲到这世界的重压稍微松一松。

lines.en: : But what if one of the girls is really mad that you were gone for so long and then rapes and dismembers you as revenge?
lines.zh: : 可万一有个女孩因为你消失了这么久特别生气，然后为了报复先奸后把你大卸八块怎么办？

lines.en: : In that order?
lines.zh: : 按这个顺序？

lines.en: : The order doesn’t matter! The point is you’ll still be getting hurt and I can’t let that happen! I won’t let that happen! I’m supposed to protect you! I’m supposed to-
lines.zh: : 顺序不重要！重点是你还是会受伤，我不能让那种事发生！我不会让它发生！我应该保护你的！我应该——

lines.en: : Ami.
lines.zh: : Ami。

lines.en: : Please shut the fuck up.
lines.zh: : 请你他妈的闭嘴。

lines.en: : Sensei!
lines.zh: : Sensei！

lines.en: : I made a decision. And you can either stand by and support me, or you can put me in a box where I’ll never have any free will or conscious thought for the rest of my life.
lines.zh: : 我已经做了决定。你要么站在我这边支持我，要么就把我塞进一个盒子里，让我这辈子再也别想有任何自由意志和自主思想。

lines.en: : Ooh, I like the box option. Let’s do that. I can even put a little succulent in there with you so you can have some enrichment.
lines.zh: : 哦，我喜欢盒子那个选项。就这么办吧。我甚至还能在里面给你放一小盆多肉，好让你有点生活调剂。

lines.en: : Please...just be a good girl.
lines.zh: : 求你了……就当个乖女孩吧。

lines.en: : Oh, you don’t have to worry about that. I promise to be as good as I can possibly be.
lines.zh: : 哦，这点你不用担心。我保证会尽可能乖。

lines.en: : But, just so you know, some of the girls might be reeeeeeeeeaaaaally mad that I kept you all to myself for so long! So you need to be ready to deal with that and explain to them that I was right the whole time!
lines.zh: : 不过，你先有个心理准备，有些女孩可能会因为我这么久把你一个人霸占着而生——气——得不得了！所以你得准备好应付，还要跟她们解释清楚，我自始至终都是对的！

lines.en: : Yeah. I’m expecting as much. But, if all goes according to plan, we won’t be here all that long to begin with.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我早有预料。不过，如果一切按计划进行，我们本来也不会在这里待太久。

lines.en: : Oh, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 哦，Sensei……

lines.en: scene black
: Things {i}never{/i} go according to plan.
lines.zh: : 事情{i}从来{/i}都不会按计划进行。

lines.en: When Ami and I make it to school, I manage to sever the stitches she sewed onto my hip and convince her to go wait for me in class.
lines.zh: 我和 Ami 到了学校后，我总算弄断了她缝在我胯上的那些线，并说服她先去教室里等我。

lines.en: And while I also asked her to inform everyone that I’ll actually be {i}here{/i} today so as to not shock them half to death, I doubt she’ll listen.
lines.zh: 虽然我也让她去通知大家，说我今天真的{i}会来{/i}，免得把她们吓得半死，但我怀疑她不会照做。

lines.en: In fact, she hasn’t listened to much of {i}anything{/i} this last week as she’s still convinced I’m not fit to decide anything for myself.
lines.zh: 事实上，这一周以来她{i}什么{/i}都听不进去，因为她仍然认定我没有能力为自己做任何决定。

lines.en: And maybe she’s right.
lines.zh: 也许她是对的。

lines.en: Maybe I should just listen to her and take on a new role as her puppet instead of her uncle. I’m sure the hours would be better.
lines.zh: 也许我该听她的，换个新角色，当她的傀儡而不是她的舅舅。起码工作时间肯定会好一些。

lines.en: But I’m also sure that {i}both{/i} of those roles have the same exact, colossal problem.
lines.zh: 但我也确信，这{i}两个{/i}角色都有一个一模一样的、巨大的问题。

lines.en: Ami.
lines.zh: Ami。

lines.en: I think I’m breaking her.
lines.zh: 我觉得我正在把她弄坏。

lines.en: scene back2school13
: ...and if we divide the hours like this instead, both of our classes should have adequate time to use the gymnasium as training for sports day.
lines.zh: : ……如果我们改成这样分配时间，我们两个班都应该有足够的时间用体育馆来为运动会做训练。

lines.en: : Training? We’ve gotta train for that shit? Just take the damn W, Wakana. My girls are way too down in the dumps to be focusing on athletics right now.
lines.zh: : 训练？那种破事还得训练？直接把胜利拿走不就得了，Wakana。我的姑娘们现在一个个都丧得不行，哪有心思搞体育。

lines.en: : I used to love sports day when I was in high school. But I had this weird problem where I always wound up making out with somebody on one of the opposing teams.
lines.zh: : 我高中的时候可喜欢运动会了。不过我有个怪毛病，总是会跟对方队伍里的某个人亲热起来。

lines.en: : That’s wonderful, Rika. Now, as I was saying-
lines.zh: : 真棒啊，Rika。那么，我刚才说到——

lines.en: scene back2school14
: Maybe I have a thing for villains? Do you guys look at the opposing team as-
lines.zh: : 也许我就是喜欢反派？你们会不会把对方队伍当成——

lines.en: scene back2school15

: Jeeeesus Christ! When did {i}you{/i} get there? You nearly gave me a heart attack. I’m old, you know. You have to be careful around me. I’m fragile. Also, {i}why{/i} did you get there? What’s happening? Hello.
lines.zh: : 我的天哪！你{i}什么时候{/i}到那儿的？你差点把我吓出心脏病。我老了，你知道的。在我身边你得小心点。我很脆弱。还有，你{i}为什么{/i}会出现在那儿？发生什么事了？喂。

lines.en: scene back2school16
: Rika, pay attention.
lines.zh: : Rika，专心点。

lines.en: scene back2school17
: This applies to you even {i}if{/i} you’re not actually a teacher. I’m going to need your help setting up the cones for-
lines.zh: : 就算你{i}其实{/i}不是老师，这话对你也一样适用。我还需要你帮忙把那些锥筒摆好，用来——

lines.en: : Wakana...look...
lines.zh: : Wakana……你看……

lines.en: scene back2school18
: Why? Surely you have a hall pass if you’re going to interrupt-
lines.zh: : 为什么？你要中途插话，总该有张通行证吧——

lines.en: scene back2school19
: Ara...kawa...
lines.zh: : Ara……kawa……

lines.en: : Hey...
: Long time, no see.
lines.zh: : 好久不见。

lines.en: scene back2school20
: Hold this.
lines.zh: : 拿着这个。

lines.en: : Huh? What?
lines.zh: : 啊？什么？

lines.en: : {i}Psst...I think you should run.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}嘘……我觉得你该跑了。{/i}

lines.en: : Wakana-
lines.zh: : Wakana——

lines.en: scene back2school21
: Hey! I said {i}I{/i} was gonna do that!
lines.zh: : 喂！我说了{i}我{/i}来动手！

lines.en: scene back2school22
: You bastard! Do you have {i}any{/i} idea how worried we’ve been?! How hard Imani has had to work because of {i}your{/i} absence?! Do you?!
lines.zh: : 你这混蛋！你{i}到底{/i}知不知道我们有多担心？！因为{i}你{/i}不在，Imani 一个人扛得有多辛苦？！你知道吗？！

lines.en: : I thought we weren’t allowed to hit people in school?
lines.zh: : 我还以为学校里不许打人呢？

lines.en: : I didn’t mean to-
lines.zh: : 我不是故意——

lines.en: scene back2school23
: I don’t give a flying fuck, Arakawa! You have a responsibility as a {i}teacher{/i} to not pull shit like this!
lines.zh: : 我才他妈的管不了那么多，Arakawa！你身为一名{i}老师{/i}，就有责任不干这种事！

lines.en: : When you don’t show up for work, the rest of {i}us{/i} have to suffer! Do you understand that?!
lines.zh: : 你不上班，剩下的{i}我们{/i}就得跟着受罪！你明白吗？！

lines.en: : I...yeah. I get it.
lines.zh: : 我……嗯。我明白。

lines.en: : Bullshit! You’ve never understood a single {i}thing{/i} about this job! And now you’re going to pretend you {i}do{/i} just because you’re being yelled at?! How weak are you?!
lines.zh: : 放屁！这份工作你从来没有弄懂过{i}哪怕一件事{/i}！现在就因为被人吼了两句，你就打算装作自己{i}懂{/i}了？！你到底有多软弱？！

lines.en: : Wakana, take it easy! People are going to start showing up soon! You’re causing a scene!
lines.zh: : Wakana，冷静点！马上就要有人来了！你这是在闹事！

lines.en: : Look at me you, piece of shit! Fucking look at me, Arakawa!
lines.zh: : 看着我，你这坨狗屎！他妈的看着我，Arakawa！

lines.en: : I {i}am{/i} looking at you. What else do you want from me?
lines.zh: : 我{i}正{/i}看着你呢。你还想让我怎么样？

lines.en: : Fuck you! Fuck you, fuck you, fuck you!
lines.zh: : 去你的！去你的，去你的，去你的！

lines.en: scene back2school24
: Fuck you, fuck you, fuck you, fuck you, fuck you, fuck you, fuck you, fuck you!!!!
lines.zh: : 去你的，去你的，去你的，去你的，去你的，去你的，去你的，去你的！！！！

lines.en: : Woah.
lines.zh: : 哇哦。

lines.en: scene back2school25
: You absolute dick! You complete imbecile! You petulant child! Where do you get off?!
lines.zh: : 你这个彻头彻尾的混蛋！你这个十足的蠢货！你这个任性的小孩！你凭什么？！

lines.en: : Since when does Wakana have feelings? I thought {i}I{/i} was the feelings teacher.
lines.zh: : Wakana 什么时候也有感情了？我还以为{i}我{/i}才是那个负责感情的老师。

lines.en: : You’re not even a teacher, Rika.
lines.zh: : 你连老师都不是，Rika。

lines.en: : Oh, right.
lines.zh: : 哦，对哦。

lines.en: scene back2school26
: Hey, wait a minute! That’s the guy {i}you{/i} want to hug! And I don’t know you two well enough to choose sides yet!
lines.zh: : 嘿，等一下！那可是{i}你{/i}想抱的人啊！而且我跟你俩还不够熟，还不知道该站哪边呢！

lines.en: : Yeah...even I’m a little surprised by this sudden development and Wakana’s the best girlfriend I’ve ever had.
lines.zh: : 是啊……就连我都对这突发状况有点吃惊，而 Wakana 可是我交过的最好的女朋友。

lines.en: : What? You two are dating? Does Osako know?
lines.zh: : 什么？你俩在交往？Osako 知道吗？

lines.en: : Rika, stop talking.
lines.zh: : Rika，别说了。

lines.en: scene back2school27
: Hey! No hugging in the hall! You’re making the rest of us jealous!
lines.zh: : 喂！走廊上不准抱抱！你们搞得我们其他人嫉妒死了！

lines.en: : Arakawa, you fucking asshole!
lines.zh: : Arakawa，你这该死的混蛋！

lines.en: scene back2school28
: Two months?! Really?! Without even calling?! In what twisted world of yours is that okay?! How would you feel if {i}we{/i} disappeared for that long?!
lines.zh: : 两个月？！真的假的？！连个电话都不打？！在你那扭曲的世界里这算正常吗？！如果{i}我们{/i}消失那么久，你会是什么感受？！

lines.en: : Don’t answer that! Your extended vacation is proof enough that you don’t care at all! But I...{i}we{/i} do! We care about you, Arakawa! Running away won’t fix anything!
lines.zh: : 别回答！你那超长假期本身就足够证明你根本一点也不在乎！但我……{i}我们{/i}在乎！我们在乎你，Arakawa！逃避解决不了任何问题！

lines.en: : I...didn’t mean to-
lines.zh: : 我……不是故意的——

lines.en: : Fuck it. I’m going in.
lines.zh: : 管他呢。我上了。

lines.en: scene back2school29
: Going in? What do you mean you’re {i}going in?{/i}
lines.zh: : 上了？你说{i}上了{/i}是什么意思？

lines.en: : If I don’t make it back, tell my daughter I love her. She’s the one who looks extra lesbian now.
lines.zh: : 如果我回不来，告诉我女儿我爱她。就是现在看起来格外像个拉拉的那个。

lines.en: : Bitch, I know who yo’ god damn daughter is.
lines.zh: : 贱人，我当然知道你他妈的女儿是谁。

lines.en: scene back2school30
: Yeaaaah! Family reunion! I’m adopting all of you!
lines.zh: : 耶——！家庭团聚！我要收养你们所有人！

lines.en: : Get...off of me! I’m scolding Arakawa right now!
lines.zh: : 给……我滚开！我正在训 Arakawa 呢！

lines.en: : Well stop because that’s my job as his new mom!
lines.zh: : 那你别训了，因为那是他新妈妈我的活儿！

lines.en: scene back2school31
: Rika! Let...go! You’re heavy!
lines.zh: : Rika！松……手！你好重！

lines.en: : That’s no way to talk to your mother!
lines.zh: : 怎么能这么跟你妈说话！

lines.en: : A little help, Imani?
lines.zh: : 帮个忙行吗，Imani？

lines.en: : Help?...
: {i}Now{/i} you want help?
lines.zh: : {i}现在{/i}想起要帮忙了？

lines.en: : Wakana’s not the only one who’s shed tears over this, dude.
lines.zh: : 为这事掉过眼泪的可不止 Wakana 一个，老兄。

lines.en: : I’m not crying! I’m just really, really mad!
lines.zh: : 我才没哭！我只是非常、非常生气！

lines.en: : Yeah, well so am I. And if Wakana hadn’t already risked giving you brain damage, I’d be smacking you right now too.
lines.zh: : 是吗，我也一样。要不是 Wakana 已经冒着把你打成脑损伤的风险先动手了，我现在也想揍你一顿。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, okay?
lines.zh: : 对不起，行了吧？

lines.en: scene back2school32
: To all three of you. That’s why I’m here. Now, could you please let go of me so I can explain?
lines.zh: : 对你们三个都是。所以我才来这儿。现在，能请你们松开我，好让我解释一下吗？

lines.en: scene black
scene back2school33
: Wait, so you’re sad and you can’t even explain {i}why{/i} you’re sad?
lines.zh: : 等等，所以你很难过，却连{i}为什么{/i}难过都说不出来？

lines.en: : I know exactly why I’m “sad.” It’s just kind of hard to talk about it without wanting to rip my veins out and strangle myself with them.
lines.zh: : 我清楚得很自己为什么「难过」。只是一谈起这个，我就会想把血管扯出来勒死自己，所以不太好开口。

lines.en: : It’s still that bad?
lines.zh: : 还是那么糟吗？

lines.en: : I mean...I can get out of bed now. That’s good, right?
lines.zh: : 怎么说呢……我现在能下床了。这算好事吧？

lines.en: : Not if you’re still feeling like shit, Senpai. I’m sure the last thing any of {i}us{/i} want is to have to unwrap your arterial noose.
lines.zh: : 如果你还是觉得生不如死，那就不算，前辈。我敢说，{i}我们{/i}谁都不想帮你解开那根缠在脖子上的动脉。

lines.en: : Arteries and veins are different, Imani. Arakawa said nothing about arteries.
lines.zh: : 动脉和静脉不一样，Imani。Arakawa 可没提过动脉。

lines.en: scene back2school34
: Yeah- I’m aware, Wakana. But {i}veinal{/i} doesn’t sound very good, so excuse me for bending his words a little.
lines.zh: : 是——我知道，Wakana。但{i}「静脉的」{/i}这词听着实在不怎么样，所以原谅我稍微曲解了一下他的话。

lines.en: : If you’re feeling that terrible, you shouldn’t have come here. You could have just called.
lines.zh: : 既然你这么难受，就不该来这儿。打个电话就行了。

lines.en: : I figured I owed it to you and all of the girls to at least show my face after all this time.
lines.zh: : 我觉得过了这么久，我起码欠你和所有女孩一个露面。

lines.en: scene back2school35
: Plus, if I’m ever going to stop feeling like I’m drowning in a sea of shit, I’m probably going to have to leave the house. Maybe. Or maybe not, I don’t really know. I’m very, very bad at this.
lines.zh: : 再说，如果我想不再觉得自己泡在一片屎海里快要淹死，大概总得走出家门。也许吧。也许不用，我也真不清楚。这种事我非常、非常不擅长。

lines.en: : I can tell. I haven’t ever seen you, like...{i}desperate{/i} before. You look...actually broken right now.
lines.zh: : 看得出来。我从没见过你这副……{i}绝望{/i}的样子。你现在看起来……是真的碎了。

lines.en: : Yeah. Well, that’s probably because that’s exactly how I feel.
lines.zh: : 嗯。大概是因为我确实就是那种感觉吧。

lines.en: : And there’s no sense in hiding it anymore because I’m pretty sure the part of my brain that allowed me to do that has gone rotten and won’t do its fucking job for more than five seconds at a time now.
lines.zh: : 而且再藏着也没意义了，因为我敢肯定，我脑子里负责掩饰的那块已经烂掉了，现在连五秒钟都干不好它的活儿。

lines.en: : Maybe that’s a good thing? I can’t guarantee that any of us can help, but we’ve all gone through tough shit before too. And we’ve got six perfectly good shoulders to cry on.
lines.zh: : 也许那是件好事？我不敢保证我们谁能帮上忙，但我们也都经历过难熬的事。而且我们有六副好肩膀可以给你靠着哭。

lines.en: : Four. Arakawa will hurt my back and his tears will ruin my clothes. He can cry on you two instead.
lines.zh: : 四副。Arakawa 会压坏我的背，他的眼泪还会毁了我的衣服。让他去靠你们俩哭吧。

lines.en: : Thanks, Wakana.
lines.zh: : 谢了，Wakana。

lines.en: : Fuck you. I’m going to class.
lines.zh: : 去你的。我去上课了。

lines.en: scene back2school36
: Wakana, you forgot your clipboard.
lines.zh: : Wakana，你忘了你的夹板。

lines.en: : Keep it. Study it. Do whatever you want. I have work to do.
lines.zh: : 你留着吧。研究研究。随你怎么办。我有活儿要干。

lines.en: : So, what? You’re just going to show your face in class and then go home? Do you want me to walk with you? It’s not like I have anything going on literally ever.
lines.zh: : 所以呢？你就打算在班上露个脸然后回家？要我陪你走走吗？反正我这人向来是无事可做。

lines.en: : Is that okay, Imani?
lines.zh: : 可以吗，Imani？

lines.en: scene back2school37
: Do you even need to ask? Of course it’s okay. I’ll hold down the fort until you’re ready to come back for real. And until then, if there’s anything else you need, {i}please{/i} tell me.
lines.zh: : 这还用问吗？当然可以。我会替你守着摊子，直到你真正准备好回来。在那之前，如果你还需要什么，{i}拜托{/i}跟我说。

lines.en: : You know, it’s kind of crazy just how many people have said that to me.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，跟我说过这话的人多得有点离谱。

lines.en: : It’s not crazy at all. It just means a lot of people love you.
lines.zh: : 一点都不离谱。这只说明有很多人爱你。

lines.en: : I get that. But what I meant was more along the lines of, “I have so many options of people to talk to, yet I can’t figure out how to talk to {i}any{/i} of them.” And that idea is pretty crazy, don’t you think?
lines.zh: : 这我懂。但我想说的更像是——「我有那么多人可以倾诉，却不知道该怎么跟{i}任何一个人{/i}开口。」这个念头挺疯狂的吧，你不觉得吗？

lines.en: : Like...I’m hanging off a cliff and looking up at a ton of beautiful girls who want to pull me up, but I’m worried that taking their hand will just send both of us falling instead.
lines.zh: : 就好比……我挂在悬崖边上，抬头看着一大堆想把我拉上去的漂亮女孩，可我又怕一握住她们的手，反而会把我们两个一起拽下去。

lines.en: : Not me. I have excellent grip strength.
lines.zh: : 我可不会。我握力特别好。

lines.en: : Yeah, grab Rika’s hand. Mine sweat when I get anxious and I don’t like heights very much.
lines.zh: : 对，去抓 Rika 的手。我一紧张手心就出汗，而且我不太喜欢高处。

lines.en: : Either way, thanks. I don’t know. My head’s still not on right. And I have no clue when it will be, so it’s probably best to just avoid me for a little while.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，谢了。我不知道。我的脑袋还没装好。也不知道什么时候能装好，所以你们最好还是先躲我一阵子。

lines.en: : Or forever. That works too.
lines.zh: : 或者永远躲着也行。那也可以。

lines.en: : Are you saying you don’t want to be friends anymore?
lines.zh: : 你是说你不想再做朋友了？

lines.en: : I’m saying I was never a good friend in the first place. And considering I’m just a shittier version of my old shitty self now, there’s nothing to get out of maintaining a relationship with me.
lines.zh: : 我是说，我打一开始就不是一个好朋友。而且考虑到我现在不过是个更烂版本的、原本就很烂的自己，跟我维持关系也得不到什么。

lines.en: : Do you want to be friends or not? Just give it to us straight. We’re all adults here.
lines.zh: : 你到底想不想做朋友？痛痛快快说清楚。这里都是成年人。

lines.en: : I do.
lines.zh: : 我想。

lines.en: : Of course I do.
lines.zh: : 我当然想。

lines.en: : Imani-
lines.zh: : Imani——

lines.en: : If you tell me I’m like a sister to you I swear to fucking god that I will break your nose.
lines.zh: : 你要是敢说我把你当妹妹，我对天发誓我一定打烂你的鼻子。

lines.en: : That’s not what I was going to say. But, I have a hard time describing the way I feel about you anyway, so I’ll just say you’re extremely important to me and leave it at that.
lines.zh: : 我本来不是要说那个。不过我也确实很难形容我对你的感觉，所以我就只说你对我极其重要，就这样吧。

lines.en: scene back2school38
: And Rika...I’m sorry if I gave you the wrong idea about our relationship before. I’m a douchebag and I didn’t mean it.
lines.zh: : 还有 Rika……如果以前让你误解了我们之间的关系，我很抱歉。我就是个混蛋，不是有意的。

lines.en: : Apology accepted. But...and sorry if I’m completely mistaken in saying this...I was told you were the type who never really apologizes about {i}anything.{/i} Or...never wants to change and...stuff like that.
lines.zh: : 接受你的道歉。不过……要是我完全说错了先说声抱歉……我听说你是那种{i}任何事{/i}都从不真正道歉的人。或者……从来不想改变，之类的。

lines.en: : Right now, though...that’s not the way you seem at all. Right now, it’s like you’re actually {i}trying{/i} to be a better person. So, like...isn’t that a good thing?
lines.zh: : 但现在……你看起来完全不是那样。现在感觉你真的在{i}努力{/i}变成一个更好的人。所以……这难道不是好事吗？

lines.en: : Why are you being so down on yourself when you’re trying so hard?
lines.zh: : 你都这么努力了，为什么还要这么贬低自己？

lines.en: : Because I don’t think that’s what’s happening here.
lines.zh: : 因为我不觉得事情是这样。

lines.en: scene back2school39
: Well...what do you think it is, then?
lines.zh: : 那……你觉得是什么？

lines.en: scene black
: I think I’m a cornered animal.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我是一头被逼到绝境的野兽。

lines.en: : And I’m just saying what I think will keep me out of harm’s way.
lines.zh: : 我只是说着那些我觉得能让自己免于受伤的话。
